about: The data a SaaS product site keeps. The page itself is not stored in the database: it is rendered from the brief, written into code at build time. Only the email list is data.

fields.name: source
fields.note: From a ?src= or utm_source parameter, else 'direct'. Max 60 characters.

fields.name: placement
fields.note: Which email box was used: hero or closing. Optional.

entities.name: Owner
entities.note: Not stored. One owner from environment configuration: an email and a password hash.

rules: A Signup's email is unique. A second submission of the same email updates nothing and shows the same success message.
Deleting a Signup removes it permanently. There is no soft delete in this version.

Page content (headline, pills, steps, plans, quotes, footer) lives in one typed content file written from the brief at build time. It is not editable in an owner screen; changes are made by asking the builder.
